page.layout: One page of verse. Running head top left, page number top right. Upper block: verse stanzas, the first continuing from the previous page. Below a rule: a small title in capitals, then a second block of verse stanzas. Signature at the lower right.

p.i:
Cautes, saxáve, quoduis
Cœco calcat iter gradu.

Neglexere bonis credere vatibus,
Quorum lingua sonos sæpe dedit sacra
Tales. State profestis
Cuncti[?] sordibus, ô, procul.

Hæc tandem exitium causa nepotibus
Sancti fædifragis intulit Abrahæ,
Victorumque superbis
Iußit nutibus obsequi.

Sic pulsi patriis sedibus exulant,
Subiectaque aliis solibus incolunt
Terras. Et ferus omnem
Hostis spem reditus demit.

Fulminantis ira cœli
Et ore summi Iudicis feruens furor
Dissipaunt[?] huc & illuc
Isacidas tot cædibus superstites.

Non volet misertus illos
Posthac sereno recreare lumine.
Hostium ferox caterva
Vittis verendos Pontificum vultus sacris

Spreuit, infulæque clarum
Decus: senumque debiles risit choros
Quum potentior superbo

page.notes: Printed lines are verse; line breaks within each stanza are kept as printed. Doubtful readings marked [?]: "Cuncti" (type partly worn), "Dissipaunt" (the vowel and the word-initial letters are faint). The word "huc" may be read differently. No marginal notes, no catchword. The bottom right mark "C 3" is read as a gathering signature.
